searchText: What do EL client devs think about 6780? The current proposal feels quite hacky, is that really the final spec? Nethermind already implemented it here: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/4704 My personal opinion is that it is not hacky. It is a very viable solution to a problem that is tough to solve otherwise. Thanks! There are other proposals, so agree it's a tough problem but that's not the only possible solution. FWIW, we had discussed the other proposals on the last ACDE (I think?) and it seemed like this one was favored by client teams. that said, we are waiting for a full impact analysis of 6780, and agreed yesterday to re-evaluate once that is out + make spec changes if necessary
